sections.heading: Logical layout
sections.text: Each position retains its own type and admitted layout.

sections.heading: Construction and members
sections.text: Tuple.of(values); positional operations require a compile-time valid position.

sections.heading: Protocols and ownership
sections.text: Each element keeps its declared type and ownership. Positional/map operations must preserve the admitted aggregate shape; a successful scalar example does not grant arbitrary Copy/clone for owned elements. Borrowed element views remain bounded by the aggregate owner lifetime.

sections.heading: Errors, limits and target
sections.text: Use x86_64 Linux System V ELF for the executed examples. Incompatible types reject before publication; bounds and ownership checks precede an invalid read, mutation or drop. Internal descriptor layouts are not portable ABI promises.
